influences.name: Phil Collins
influences.context: On his initial solo albums, he partnered with Phil Collins -- the man with the golden touch when it came to early '80s mainstream rock that could be ground-breaking and massively popular simultaneously

influences.name: Soundgarden
influences.context: A song like "Calling To You" at once sounds almost like something Soundgarden themselves could've written for 1994's Superunknown and also lets you imagine what a '90s Zeppelin record could've been like

influences.name: Jeff Buckley
influences.context: there are songs on Walking Into Clarksdale that sound like Page and Plant filtering themselves through people they inspired, like Soundgarden or Jeff Buckley

influences.name: Alison Krauss
influences.context: On some of these albums, he dove headlong into one thing, like 2007's collaboration with Alison Krauss, the acclaimed roots album Raising Sand

influences.name: T Bone Burnett
influences.context: the two of them, with the guiding hand of T Bone Burnett, made a great album together

influences.name: The Everly Brothers
influences.context: Originally a sunny '60s pop track by the Everly Brothers, the rendition on Raising Sand was consistent with the atmosphere of the record

influences.name: Leadbelly
influences.context: What started as a casual invitation to sing Leadbelly at a tribute turned into the Grammy-stacking Raising Sand
